key: Hail, Trainer.
en: Hail, Trainer.
ja: やあ、トレーナー。

key: City watch is on the look-out for trouble. If you see anything suspicious, please report it to us.
en: City watch is on the look-out for trouble. If you see anything suspicious, please report it to us.
ja: 自警団はトラブルに目を光らせている。何か怪しいものを見かけたら、我々に報告してくれ。

key: <>- Willowreed Road\n^ - Crystal Street
en: <>- Willowreed Road\n^ - Crystal Street
ja: <>- ウィローリード通り\n^ - クリスタル通り

key: <>- Heatherhill Lane\nv - Yellow Street
en: <>- Heatherhill Lane\nv - Yellow Street
ja: <>- ヘザーヒル小路\nv - イエロー通り

key: <>- Heatherhill Lane\nv - Crystal Street
en: <>- Heatherhill Lane\nv - Crystal Street
ja: <>- ヘザーヒル小路\nv - クリスタル通り

key: Tch, the police being back in full is great and all.
en: Tch, the police being back in full is great and all.
ja: チッ、警察が全面復帰したのはいいことだけどな。

key: But they go a little overboard sometimes, you know?
en: But they go a little overboard sometimes, you know?
ja: でも時々ちょっとやりすぎることもあるよな、わかるだろ?

key: Not with everyone, sure, but I think we both know what kind of people they'd be targeting.
en: Not with everyone, sure, but I think we both know what kind of people they'd be targeting.
ja: みんなに対してってわけじゃないけどよ、どんな連中が狙われるかはお互いわかってるだろ。

key: GROWLITHE: Grrowrrr!?
en: GROWLITHE: Grrowrrr!?
ja: ガーディ:ガウッ!?

key: Well, never thought I'd end up in a place like this.
en: Well, never thought I'd end up in a place like this.
ja: いやはや、こんな場所に落ち着くことになるとは思わなかったよ。

key: Nice city, but since they built this old folks' home up here, my son decided he didn't want me loafing around his place anymore.
en: Nice city, but since they built this old folks' home up here, my son decided he didn't want me loafing around his place anymore.
ja: いい街だが、ここに老人ホームができたもんだから、息子が俺にもう自分のところをうろつかれたくないってな。

key: Ohoho... It stings, but I can understand.
en: Ohoho... It stings, but I can understand.
ja: おほほ……ちょっと堪えるが、まあわかるよ。

key: "Reborn City Police Station"
en: "Reborn City Police Station"
ja: 「リボーンシティ警察署」

key: Don't get me wrong, I'm grateful that the Jasper Ward has been rebuilt.
en: Don't get me wrong, I'm grateful that the Jasper Ward has been rebuilt.
ja: 誤解しないでくれよ、ジャスパーワードが再建されたのはありがたいと思ってる。

key: But if I could go back to the way things were before...
en: But if I could go back to the way things were before...
ja: でも前の状態に戻れるなら……

key: I wouldn't even think twice about it.
en: I wouldn't even think twice about it.
ja: 迷わずそうするけどな。

key: No matter how bright the future may be, it's meaningless if the people you care about aren't in it.
en: No matter how bright the future may be, it's meaningless if the people you care about aren't in it.
ja: どれだけ明るい未来だろうと、大切な人がそこにいないなら意味がない。

key: Since the old one was destroyed, the city decided to build a new medical clinic into the Pokémon Center.
en: Since the old one was destroyed, the city decided to build a new medical clinic into the Pokémon Center.
ja: 前のが壊れちまったから、街はポケモンセンターの中に新しい診療所を作ることにしたんだ。

key: That would be nice, if anyone below the age of 70 could even afford service...
en: That would be nice, if anyone below the age of 70 could even afford service...
ja: 70歳未満でも治療費を払えるならいい話なんだけどな……

key: "Heatherhill Station"
en: "Heatherhill Station"
ja: 「ヘザーヒル駅」

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: カギが　かかっている

key: "Miracle Eye Medium--\nNewly reopened!"
en: "Miracle Eye Medium--\nNewly reopened!"
ja: 「ミラクルアイ霊媒師――\n新装開店!」

key: Not so fast, Trainer!
en: Not so fast, Trainer!
ja: 待ちな、トレーナー!

key: We are the guardians of this place!
en: We are the guardians of this place!
ja: あたしたちはこの場所の守り手よ!

key: A great fortune was stolen from here...
en: A great fortune was stolen from here...
ja: ここから大きな財宝が盗まれたの……

key: So we're here to protect this place from any further harm!
en: So we're here to protect this place from any further harm!
ja: だからあたしたちは、これ以上の被害からここを守るためにいるの!

key: You're going down, trespasser!
en: You're going down, trespasser!
ja: 覚悟しな、不法侵入者!

key: No, the fortune!
en: No, the fortune!
ja: 違う、財宝の方よ!

key: It was supposed to be ours!
en: It was supposed to be ours!
ja: あたしたちのものになるはずだったのに!

key: Hmph... So much for that plan.
en: Hmph... So much for that plan.
ja: フン……その計画もこれまでね。

key: By guarding this house and taking the fortune from whoever found it, we were hoping to guarantee ourselves a cut of the reward.
en: By guarding this house and taking the fortune from whoever found it, we were hoping to guarantee ourselves a cut of the reward.
ja: この家を守って、見つけた誰かから財宝を奪えば、あたしたちも報酬の分け前にありつけると思ってたのよ。

key: But it seems like that won't work anymore...
en: But it seems like that won't work anymore...
ja: でももうそれも無理みたいね……

key: Bah!
en: Bah!
ja: ふん!

key: That great fortune the old broad spoke of probably isn't that much anyway.
en: That great fortune the old broad spoke of probably isn't that much anyway.
ja: あのばあさんが言ってた大きな財宝だって、どうせ大したことないんでしょ。

key: What a waste of time! We're out of here!
en: What a waste of time! We're out of here!
ja: 時間の無駄だったわ!行くわよ!

ja: <>- ヘザーヒル小路\nv - プラチナ通り
